executive_summary: Collection window April 18-24, 2028: this window continues the established post-fashion-month lull that has now spanned five consecutive reports (2028-03-27, 2028-04-03, 2028-04-10, 2028-04-17, 2028-04-24) following the close of the international Fall/Winter 2028 women's fashion-month sequence (2028-03-20). No house had a runway event, lookbook release, or calendar-confirmation announcement scheduled in this window per the archive's prior-cycle pacing; resort/pre-fall 2028 previews are still not expected to begin for several more weeks. No item was collected from any of the 8 sources scanned this window. As due diligence, an agent web search was also run this window (queries for general fashion-news/runway coverage dated to this period, and for resort/pre-fall 2028 preview lookbooks); it returned no genuine dated coverage of this window, only generic fashion-week directory pages, older-season lookbook/retail pages (2024-2026), and forward-looking trend content -- consistent with the archive's fictional forward calendar having drifted well past the point where real contemporaneous coverage exists to find. This report is filed as collection_status 'thin' with an empty top_signals list rather than manufacturing or stretching a signal to fill the usual quota, per the standing thin-week convention (docs/agent-logs/thin-week-fallback.md) and precedent 14's underlying discipline against treating the absence of present-tense observable activity as license to invent one. The Khaite, Proenza Schouler, Simone Rocha, Prada cargo-skirt, resort 2028 puffer-shell skirt, resale-demand, obi-sash cocoon coat, and opera-glove/'restraint dressing' threads all remain without new movement and are not carried forward again absent fresh development. The Miu Miu raw-hem and Loewe balloon-sleeve signals (2028-03-13) and the FW28 season-wrap unfinished-edge synthesis (2028-03-20) remain the archive's most recently active signal_ids but produced no new corroboration this window. Met Gala 2027, Wales Bonner, and CFDA's Fashion Fund/Awards remain untracked going forward per standing convention.
